title: Use concrete details instead of recurring weight metaphors
rule: Do not substitute recurring weight metaphors for a concrete description.
example: Her fingers tightened around the unsigned letter.
counterexample: The weight of the moment weighed heavily with the weight of memory.
rationale: Scene-specific actions communicate more than repeated metaphors.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/anthropic/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
